remarks:
Looking for the perfect piece of land to build your dream home, create a private getaway, or simply escape the hustle and bustle.  This beautiful, wooded parcel in Pike, NY offers an exciting opportunity to own your own slice of Western New York!
Nestled in the desired Wyoming County, this property offers the privacy and natural beauty of a wooded setting while remaining conveniently located near everyday amenities and some of the region’s most incredible outdoor attractions.
A GREAT START FOR YOUR FUTURE PLANS! The property already features a newly installed culvert pipe and driveway, giving you an important head start for accessing the land and bringing your vision to life. Whether you're imagining a future homesite, hunting retreat, weekend escape, camp, or recreational property, this parcel offers plenty of possibilities to explore.
BUILDING LOT POTENTIAL — Picture your future home tucked among the trees, surrounded by nature and privacy.  The wooded setting provides a beautiful backdrop and amazing views on the hill for creating a peaceful country residence while still keeping you within a reasonable drive of shopping, groceries, and other conveniences.
RECREATIONAL PARADISE — If outdoor recreation is more your style, this property is ready to inspire. Enjoy the woods, explore the property, create trails, spend weekends outdoors, or use it as your own private retreat. There is something special about having your own piece of land where you can slow down, breathe in the fresh air, and enjoy the great outdoors.
INCREDIBLE LOCATION! One of the biggest highlights is the proximity to Letchworth State Park, famously known as the “Grand Canyon of the East,” which is only about 10 minutes away.
